title: HFO Suika Smash
description: An obsidian-and-gold reskin of the classic Suika/Watermelon merge game. Drop fruit, merge matching pairs, chase a bigger fruit and a higher score before the stack tops out. Built with plain JavaScript and the Matter.js physics engine.
short_description: Drop-and-merge fruit puzzle, obsidian/gold reskin of Suika.
controls: Mouse or touch: move to aim, click/tap to drop the current fruit. Merge two fruit of the same size to create the next size up and score points. Game ends if the stack rises above the top line.
platform: web (HTML5 canvas), desktop + mobile browser, no install
